description: 国王弃兵接受变 C37（费舍尔防御）— 弃兵争先三要素最干净的展示

intro.popup_en: Gambit Initiative, Lesson 1: What does a gambit buy? In the King's Gambit, White offers the f-pawn for faster development, central control, and a chance to recover the pawn later. Follow how each form of compensation comes together.
intro.popup:
弃兵争先 第1课

什么是弃兵争先？

白方第2手走f4！
主动送出一个兵——
换取什么？

这局棋是很好的例子：
白方只送一个兵，
①出子更快，②控制中心，③从容收回

跟踪这局棋，看三个补偿
如何一步步到位！

outro.popup_en: The gambit's three forms of compensation are clear: the f-file opens for White's rook, White develops all the pieces before recovering the pawn, and Nd5 establishes a powerful outpost that cannot be driven away. A gambit is not simply a lost pawn: develop first, then recover it when the position is ready.
outro.popup:
弃兵争先总结

弃兵争先三要素实现：
① 开放线路——f线为白方车所用
② 发展领先——6子出完后才收回那个兵！
③ 进攻目标——Nd5制压d5要道，无法驱逐

关键领悟：弃兵不等于丢兵
先发展到位，再从容收回——
这才是弃兵争先的精髓！

moves.popup_en: f4!! The King's Gambit. White offers the f-pawn for an open f-file, faster development, and attacking chances against Black. Watch White turn each form of compensation into an advantage.
moves.popup:
f4！！国王弃兵！

白方主动送出f兵——换取什么？

三个补偿：
① f线开放
② 更快的发展
③ 对黑方的进攻目标

看白方如何一步步兑现！

moves.popup_en: ...exf4 accepts the gambit. Black wins a pawn, but the f-file opens. White's rook on f1 will be able to use it later.
moves.popup:
exf4！黑方接受弃兵！

黑方多了一个兵……
但f线开放了！

补偿①到位：f1车将来可以沿f线直捣黄龙！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and attacks the center. The point of a gambit is not to rush to recover the pawn: develop first, build an advantage, and reclaim it when convenient.
moves.popup:
Nf3！发展马，攻击中心

弃兵争先的精髓：不急于夺回！
先发展，先建立优势，再从容收回

moves.popup_en: ...d6 is a solid defense recommended by Fischer. Black avoids trying to cling to the pawn with ...g5 and instead stabilizes the position.
moves.popup:
d6 黑方稳固防守

费舍尔推荐的最稳健应对：
不用g5贪心保兵，先把阵型稳住

moves.popup_en: Bc4! The bishop targets f7, giving White a concrete attacking target. The bishop, rook, and queen can all join the attack along this route.
moves.popup:
Bc4！象直指f7！

⭐ 补偿②：进攻目标出现！

f7是黑方最薄弱的格
象+车+后——攻击路线已成形

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops safely. Both sides bring out their pieces, but White's development has a more direct purpose.
moves.popup:
Nf6 黑方稳健发展

不贪不冒险，双方都在发展
但白方的节拍更有目的性

moves.popup_en: d4! White takes control of the center with pawns on c4, d4, and e4. The f-pawn gambit helped open lines and made this central expansion possible.
moves.popup:
d4！占领整个中心！

⭐ 补偿③：中心控制！

白方毫不费力地占据c4+d4+e4
d4之所以能成功，正是因为f4的弃兵
打开了白方的中路视野

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 continues development. Both sides have developed three pieces, but White's forces are more coordinated.
moves.popup:
Nc6 黑方继续发展

双方都已出动3子
但白方子力更加协调

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles and brings the rook to f1. The open f-file is the most direct return on the sacrificed f-pawn; White now occupies the file.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方入城！车到f1！

⭐ 弃兵的最直接补偿实现！

f线是弃f4兵换来的开放线路
车占f1——这条线路现在属于白方！

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops solidly. Black has no immediate weaknesses and the position is balanced, but White has completed most of the development.
moves.popup:
Be7 黑方稳健发展

黑方没有弱点，局面均衡
但白方已完成大部分发展

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops the final minor piece. The knights, bishops, queen, and rooks are active; this development lead is the real compensation for the pawn.
moves.popup:
Nc3！最后一个大子出动！

⭐ 白方发展完成！

马、象、后、车——全部出动！
对比黑方，白方子力协调程度领先
这就是发展领先的实质

moves.popup_en: ...O-O completes Black's castling. Both kings are safe and the position looks balanced, but where is White's advantage?
moves.popup:
O-O 黑方也完成入城

双方阵型稳固
看起来很均衡——那白方的优势在哪里？

moves.popup_en: Bxf4! White calmly recovers the pawn only after completing development. The sequence is gambit, development lead, full mobilization, then recovery. White has secured all three forms of compensation first.
moves.popup:
Bxf4！白方从容收兵！

⭐ 弃兵争先的精髓展示！

弃兵 → 优先发展 → 全部出动 → 再收回！
白方已获得所有三个补偿，现在才收那个兵

这才是真正的弃兵争先！

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black counterattacks in the center, the correct way to challenge White's central control.
moves.popup:
d5！黑方反击中心

黑方尝试打破白方的中心控制
正确方向：中心反击

moves.popup_en: e5! White advances and gains space. The d4-e5 pawn chain is strong, drives away Nf6, and restricts Black's pieces.
moves.popup:
e5！白方推进，空间扩张！

白方中心兵链 d4+e5 非常强大
驱逐Nf6，压缩黑方空间

moves.popup_en: ...Nd7 retreats the knight. Black's lack of space is becoming clear as the pieces get crowded.
moves.popup:
Nd7 黑马被迫后撤

空间劣势显现：黑方子力拥挤

moves.popup_en: Nd5!! White establishes a dominant outpost, attacking e7 and c7. The knight cannot be driven away. White gave up only the f-pawn and gained the open file, a development lead, central control, and space: one pawn for a broad positional advantage.
moves.popup:
Nd5！！白马镇守要道！

⭐ 弃兵争先的最终成果！

马占d5——统治全局中心
攻击e7和c7，无法驱逐

回顾全程：白方只送了一个f4兵
换来了：f线、发展、中心、空间
一个兵 = 全面优势！
